Messages.Author: craigs...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:
Succulent Vitae:

Only usable when a hunt action is successful. Place this card on this
acting vampire. When this vampire plays a card that requires Quietus,
he or she may burn this card to reduce the cost of that card by 1
blood.

Loss:

Blood Cost: 1

[qui] (D) Burn an equipment or location on a minion controlled by your
predator or prey.

[QUI] (D) Bleed at +2 bleed.

Rulebook (Lords of the Night) 6.2.3

"If the action is successful (all block attempts were unsuccessful),
then the cost of the action is paid..."

On a Loss bleed, I want to burn SV to reduce the cost of Loss.
Playing an action card, and paying it's cost happen at different
times. At which of these times do I burn SV - as I play Loss, or when
I pay the blood cost of Loss?

If the former, does Loss un-burn (to be usable in combat) if the
action is blocked (like Strike with Conviction), or is it just gone?

Messages.Author: Oortje
Messages.Body:


Cost is only paid on a succesdfull action. Yes this trick works.
It does not burn if you dont have to pay.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
craigs...@gmail.com wrote:
> Succulent Vitae:
>
> Only usable when a hunt action is successful. Place this card on this
> acting vampire. When this vampire plays a card that requires Quietus,
> he or she may burn this card to reduce the cost of that card by 1
> blood.

> On a Loss bleed, I want to burn SV to reduce the cost of Loss.

> Playing an action card, and paying it's cost happen at different
> times. At which of these times do I burn SV - as I play Loss, or when
> I pay the blood cost of Loss?

Card text: "When this vampire *plays* a card that requires Quietus".

So, when the vampire plays the card.

> If the former, does Loss un-burn (to be usable in combat) if the
> action is blocked (like Strike with Conviction), or is it just gone?

Just gone.

Strike with Conviction doesn't un-burn if the action is blocked. It instead
isn't burned until later, when the action resolves unblocked.
